Leaflet 1.9.4, pinned local distribution, BSD-2-Clause (see LICENSE).
Provenance: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js and leaflet.css;
license: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/v1.9.4/LICENSE .

This dependency supplies actual pan/zoom, keyboard markers and geographic
projection; it is loaded only when the map opens. No npm runtime dependency,
tracking SDK, demo key or public OSM tile/Overpass fallback is introduced.
Marker/tooltip content uses fixed values or DOM text, never untrusted HTML.

Vendored text normalizes CRLF to LF, expands CSS indentation tabs and removes
trailing whitespace for repository whitespace checks; code/license wording is unchanged.
